newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean yields end higher on Jinro loan default.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean yields end higher on Jinro loan default.

text.p: Yields on three-year benchmark corporate bonds and three-month certificates of deposit closed higher on Tuesday as news of Jinro Ltd's loan default froze buying sentiment, brokers said.
They said despite scanty new issues of 19 billion won, most investors chose to stay out of the market.
* 3-yr corporates close at 11.87 vs 11.80 on Monday
* Overnight average call rates at 11.98 vs 11.99
But unlisted Donghwa Leasing Co Ltd, which now holds about eight billion won worth of Jinro's promissory notes, said on Tuesday it would extend repayment of the notes to next February.
Brokers said in absence of any positive market-moving news corporate bond yields were likely to move between 11.80-11.90 percent until the end of this month.
